Method of Attack: Improper access control allowing arbitrary app installation via unsafe intent handling
Improper input validation allowing execution of arbitrary JavaScript via webview domain filter bypass
Impacted Systems: Samsung devices using Galaxy App Store versions prior to 4.5.49.8, excluding devices running Android 13
Attack Vector: Local access via malicious app or hyperlink
Indicators of Compromise: Unexpected app installations without user consent
Execution of JavaScript from malicious domains in Galaxy Store webviews
